# Simple GLP: GLP-1 Dose Tracker

> Simple GLP is a free GLP-1 dose tracker app for iPhone and Apple Watch. Log a weekly shot or daily pill in one tap from a widget, with dose history.

## App

- [GLP-1 Shot Tracker App | Simple GLP: GLP-1 Dose Tracker](https://jackwallner.com/ios/simpleglp/index.html.md): Simple GLP is a free GLP-1 dose tracker app for iPhone and Apple Watch. Log a weekly shot or daily pill in one tap from a widget, with dose history.

## Guides

- [Best GLP-1 Tracker App for iPhone (5 Compared)](https://jackwallner.com/ios/simpleglp/best-glp-1-tracker-app.html.md): Five iPhone GLP-1 tracker apps compared: Shotsy, MeAgain, GlucoPal, Glapp and Simple GLP. Doses, reminders, Apple Watch and accounts, as of October 2026.
- [Free GLP-1 Tracker With No Account, Private on iPhone](https://jackwallner.com/ios/simpleglp/free-glp-1-tracker-no-account.html.md): Simple GLP is a free GLP-1 tracker for iPhone and Apple Watch: no account, no ads, no third-party analytics. What is free, what Pro adds, where data lives.
- [GLP-1 Injection Site Rotation: Where to Inject](https://jackwallner.com/ios/simpleglp/glp-1-injection-site-rotation.html.md): Where Ozempic, Wegovy, Mounjaro and Zepbound instructions say to inject, what each maker says about rotating sites, and a simple way to track your last site.
- [GLP-1 Pill Wait Timer App: Time the Wait After Your Daily Pill](https://jackwallner.com/ios/simpleglp/glp-1-pill-wait-timer-app.html.md): Simple GLP starts a wait timer when you log your daily GLP-1 pill and alerts you when it ends. Set the length from your label or prescriber. Free on iPhone.
- [Log a GLP-1 Dose From Apple Watch or a Home Screen Widget](https://jackwallner.com/ios/simpleglp/log-glp-1-dose-apple-watch-widget.html.md): Simple GLP logs a weekly GLP-1 shot or daily pill in one tap from its Apple Watch app or Home Screen widget. Free, no account.
- [Ozempic and Wegovy Shot Tracker App for iPhone](https://jackwallner.com/ios/simpleglp/ozempic-wegovy-shot-tracker-app.html.md): Ozempic and Wegovy shot tracker app: Simple GLP logs each weekly shot in one tap, with reminders, Apple Watch and a widget. Free, with no account.
- [Weekly GLP-1 Shot Reminder App for iPhone and Apple Watch](https://jackwallner.com/ios/simpleglp/weekly-glp-1-shot-reminder-app.html.md): Simple GLP reminds you on GLP-1 shot day and lets you log the shot from the notification, a widget or Apple Watch. Free, with no account needed.
- [Wegovy Pill and Rybelsus Daily Dose Log App](https://jackwallner.com/ios/simpleglp/wegovy-pill-rybelsus-dose-log-app.html.md): Wegovy pill and Rybelsus daily dose log app: Simple GLP logs each pill in one tap, keeps a streak and runs a wait timer you set. Free, with no account.
- [Zepbound and Mounjaro Dose Tracker App for iPhone](https://jackwallner.com/ios/simpleglp/zepbound-mounjaro-dose-tracker-app.html.md): Zepbound and Mounjaro dose tracker app: Simple GLP logs each weekly shot in one tap, with reminders, Apple Watch and a widget. Free, with no account.
